description: Batch-update up to 500 scoped controls in one transaction (write — editor+). Each operation targets an scf_id. Material/MCR controls: no deselect (409); at_risk raises a deficiency.

operations.description: Update operations to apply (1–500 per call)

implementation_status.description: Implementation status (lowercase): not_started, in_progress, implemented, ready_for_review, monitored, not_applicable, at_risk, deferred. at_risk raises a deficiency; not_applicable on a material control needs an admin (403)

maturity_level.description: Maturity level with L prefix: L0 Not Performed, L1 Performed, L2 Planned, L3 Well Defined, L4 Quantitatively Controlled, L5 Continuously Improving

scf_id.description: SCF control identifier in DOMAIN-NN format (required, e.g., 'AST-01')

selected.description: Toggle in-scope membership. Deselecting an MCR-basis or material control is refused (409) — use scf_set_scope_override

selection_reason.description: Justification for selection — required for not_applicable or deferred

name: scf_batch_update_controls
